summary: Verified /jkhive/payroll fixes: backend Daily Sales-sourced hours, /staff dropdown endpoint, CSV export, and frontend mobile date sizing + location-scoped staff dropdown re-fetch. Backend 4/4 pytest passed. Frontend UI verifications all passed on 390x844 viewport.
critical_code_review_comments: payroll.py: sync pymongo calls (find/find_one) used inside async endpoints — non-blocking small collections so fine, but consider motor for scale.

Payroll.jsx: staffFilter reset side-effect lives inside a useEffect deps=[locFilter]; when staffFilter changes independently the effect re-runs but references stale closure of staffFilter via eslint-disable — acceptable given intent, but noting.
Payroll.jsx: `All staff (N)` counter shows active staff scoped to location, correctly updates on loc change.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payroll page is at /jkhive/payroll and requires admin auth via /admin-login. A location picker modal may show on first visit (LocationContext). Backend hours source is Daily Sales staff_hours[] matched by lowercase name. Test data has ~46h/5 names in 2025-01-01..2027-12-31 window. Staff dropdown endpoint respects staff_members.location_ids (empty=all sites).

verifications.backend_summary_hours: total_hours>0, results have hours>0, no include_drafts/any_draft keys
verifications.frontend_dropdown_populated: 4 options (All staff (3) + Alice Brown, Bob Carter, Jane Doe)
verifications.frontend_mobile_date_widths: start=157px, end=157px, same row y=228, both <=200
verifications.regression_page_load: No payroll-error, totals strip (Hours/Gross/Staff) all visible
